body: Open Source alternative to Algolia + Pinecone and an Easier-to-Use alternative to ElasticSearch ⚡ 🔍 ✨ Fast, typo tolerant, in-memory fuzzy Search Engine for building delightful search experiences
plain_description: **Give customers fast, typo-tolerant search across your products, content, or other data.** Tune rankings, filters, and sorting to shape the search experience. Run it on your own infrastructure or use Typesense Cloud.
technical_description: Typesense is an open-source, in-memory search engine with typo-tolerant keyword search, filtering, faceting, sorting, and vector, semantic, hybrid, and conversational search. It exposes an HTTP API and client libraries, supports self-hosted deployment as a native binary or Docker image, and offers a managed cloud service. The README describes indexing embeddings and using built-in models or external services such as OpenAI for semantic search.
title: Typesense
